comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary on OC_comments with the same 0/null rules, but the constructs differ. Feature 0 requires concrete labor-process details (tasks, workflow, conditions, procedures of actual work) from a personal or specific person's job. Feature 1 requires any concrete personal anecdote (a specific lived experience or event) on any topic. Feature 1 is broader, since an anecdote need not involve labor process. Feature 0 is a narrower subtype that also admits specific described third persons, whereas feature 1 limits others to people the commenter personally knows, stated first-hand.
